score_description: At each 72-hour boundary, use three nonoverlapping 90-bar blocks of pure-crypto residual return to rank persistent relative leadership and weakness. Independently rank 90-bar downside semideviation, maximum absolute return, and drawdown; encode the most fragile 20% as exact zero. For every remaining symbol, combine persistence direction, persistence rank conviction, and a monotone fragility shrink into one finite signed long-desirability score. Capture that exact dictionary once before sleeve selection; a scheduled insufficient-breadth state captures one empty dictionary. The returned sign selects side, returned magnitude orders candidates and directly shrinks base weight, and later pairing can only scale a sleeve downward.
